datasets.title: Hallem & Carlson 2006: ORN responses
datasets.description: Every ORN response the paper tabulates, as the change in spike rate from the spontaneous rate: its 110 odors at 10^-2, 10 of them at 10^-4, 10^-6 and 10^-8, and 9 fruits pure (@ 0) and at 10^-2 to 10^-6 (its supplemental tables). Each receptor as its glomerulus (DM3: Or47a). What ORN data is scaled to before a baseline model is run on it (Models tab).
datasets.source: Hallem & Carlson, Cell 125 (2006) 143-160; as tabulated in olfsysm (hc_data.csv), made by reference_data/make_hallem.py

datasets.title: Hemibrain (right calyx): PN boutons → KC claws, as the model has it
datasets.description: The model's wiring (olfsysm, prat_claws and prat_boutons, multibouton_claws='argmax'): each claw it keeps (5 or more synapses from one PN of its glomeruli, of a KC of its three types), 1 for the bouton it takes input from (of its PN's boutons, the one with the most of its synapses, ties to the lowest numbered; the claw's synapses from its PN in the synapses field). Synapses with both ends in CA(R) alone (olfsysm's loader). Each claw, bouton and APL unit has its place: x, y, z (µm, each centered on the middle of its range over the table's units of its kind) and compartment (0 within half the largest distance from their centroid, else 1), as olfsysm places the model's claws; a model claw at the mean of its synapses from its PN (the loader's claw_x/y/z and compartment), other units at the mean of the synapses Pratyush assigned to it (units labelled -1 have none). Its rows are KCs' claws (kc_id: body ID), summed per KC in the Compare tab, on KCs. 9,867 claws × 387 boutons.
datasets.source: Pratyush's hemibrain tables (2025-12-05 run), as olfsysm's pyolfsysm/data/from_pratyush/2025-12-05 has them; made by reference_data/make_connectome.py

datasets.title: Hemibrain (right calyx): PN boutons → KC claws, raw synapse counts

Its rows are KCs' claws (kc_id: body ID), summed per KC in the Compare tab, on KCs. 13,134 claws × 563 boutons.

datasets.description: The model's APL weights (olfsysm, use_connectome_APL_weights with prat_claws and prat_boutons): the synapses between APL and each of the model's claws, summed over APL's units (0 where none). The model normalizes them: only their ratios matter. The KCs (or PNs) of the right side, by the loader's steps with no ROI rule (as the KC-remapping queue's E97), the PN types' glomeruli renamed as the hemibrain's (VC3 and VC5 -> VC3, VM6 -> VC5). Each claw, bouton and APL unit has its place: x, y, z (µm, each centered on the middle of its range over the table's units of its kind) and compartment (0 within half the largest distance from their centroid, else 1), as olfsysm places the model's claws; a model claw at the mean of its synapses from its PN (the loader's claw_x/y/z and compartment), other units at the mean of the synapses Pratyush assigned to it (units labelled -1 have none). Its rows are KCs' claws (kc_id: body ID), summed per KC in the Compare tab, on KCs. 10,008 claws × 1 APL.
